title: A–Z — Cyclic Replacement Grammar
subtitle: Recurring slot windows where object-motifs enter, persist for two cycles, and yield to replacements
theorem: Advance through a fixed sequence of three structural slots [A, B, C]: in each cycle, one motif retires while a new specimen enters the freed slot, allowing viewers to deduce the replacement rule from visible recurrence.
boundary_note: The cyclic replacement index (`CYCLE 1 [A,B,C] -> CYCLE 2 [B,C,D] -> CYCLE 3 [C,D,E]`) is disclosed in the HUD without turning the historical films into mere decorative tiles.

critic_tribunal.largest_gap: Executes Frampton's exact cyclic slot replacement grammar across triptychs and individual specimen inspections (`163bcd54` cup, `7a6ff37f` crystal, `c78ec131` flower, `6f5ff11b` glass model, `85698632` miniature monument).
